parameters.description_en:
The hostname of the Elastic Computing Service server. A period (.) or a hyphen (-) cannot be used as the first or last character, or used consecutively. In addition, the naming conventions for different types of instances are as follows: 

- Windows instances: The hostname must be 2 to 15 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot contain periods (.) or consist of only digits. 
- Other instances (such as Linux): The hostname must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain multiple periods (.). Each segment between two periods (.) can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

parameters.description_en:
The number of vCPUs.

You can specify both CPU and Memory to define the range of instance types. For example, CPU=2 and Memory=16 defines all instance types with 2 vCPUs and 16 GiB of memory. Auto Scaling determines the set of active instance types based on factors such as I/O optimized settings and zones, and then creates instances of the lowest-priced instance type based on price sorting.

>This configuration takes effect only when the cost optimization pattern is enabled and no instance type is specified in the scaling configuration.
parameters.description_zh:
vCPU个数。

同时指定CPU和Memory可以定义实例规格范围，例如，CPU=2且Memory=16可以定义配置为2 vCPU和16 GiB的所有实例规格。弹性伸缩会结合I/O优化、可用区等因素确定可用实例规格集合，并根据价格排序为您创建价格最低的实例。

>该区间配置效果仅在成本优化模式下且伸缩配置未设置实例规格时生效。

parameters.description_en:
The category of the system cloud disk. Valid values:

- cloud: basic cloud disk. The DeleteWithInstance attribute of a basic cloud disk that is created together with the instance is set to true.
- cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
- cloud_essd: ESSD.
- ephemeral_ssd: local SSD.
- cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk.

You cannot specify this parameter together with `SystemDiskCategories.N`. If neither this parameter nor `SystemDiskCategories.N` is specified, the default value is used. If the instance type is a Series I instance type and the instance is a non-I/O optimized instance, the default value is cloud. Otherwise, the default value is cloud_efficiency.

parameters.description_en:
The private pool option for instance startup. A private pool is generated after an elasticity assurance or capacity reservation takes effect. You can select a private pool when you start an instance. Valid values:

- Open: open mode. The system automatically matches available open private pools. If no matching private pools are available, the public pool is used to start the instance. You do not need to specify PrivatePoolOptions.Id.

- Target: specified mode. A specified private pool is used to start the instance. If the specified private pool is unavailable, the instance fails to start. You must specify the private pool ID, which means that PrivatePoolOptions.Id is required.

- None: none mode. No private pool is used to start the instance.
parameters.description_zh:

element_fields.description_en:
If you want to specify the capacity of instance types in the scaling configuration, specify this parameter after you specify InstanceTypeOverride.N.InstanceType. The two parameters must correspond to each other, and the values of N must be consistent.

This parameter specifies the weight of the instance type, which indicates the capacity that a single instance of this type represents in the scaling group. A larger weight means fewer instances of this type are required to meet the expected capacity.

Because instance types differ in vCPU count, memory size, and other performance metrics, you can assign different weights to different instance types based on your requirements.

Example:

- Current capacity: 0.
- Expected number of instances: 6.
- Capacity of ecs.c5.xlarge: 4.

To meet the expected capacity, the scaling group scales out 2 ecs.c5.xlarge instances.

>During scale-out, the capacity of the scaling group cannot exceed the sum of the maximum capacity (MaxSize) and the maximum weight of the instance types.

Valid values of WeightedCapacity: 1 to 500.
element_fields.description_zh:
当您需要指定伸缩配置中实例规格的容量时，在指定InstanceTypeOverride.N.InstanceType后，再指定本参数。两个参数一一对应，N需要保持一致。

本参数用于指定实例规格的权重，即实例规格的单台实例在伸缩组中表示的容量大小。权重越大，满足期望容量所需的本实例规格的实例数量越少。

由于每个实例规格的vCPU个数、内存大小等性能指标会有差异，您可以根据自身需求，给不同的实例规格配置不同的权重。

 例如：

- 当前容量：0。
- 期望容量：6。
- ecs.c5.xlarge规格容量：4。

为满足期望容量，伸缩组将为用户扩容2台ecs.c5.xlarge实例。

>扩容时伸缩组的容量不得超过最大容量（MaxSize）与实例规格的最大权重之和。

WeightedCapacity的取值范围：1~500。

Note the following information:

- The InstancePatternInfo.N parameter applies only to scaling groups whose network type is VPC.

- If you have specified instance types by using InstanceType or InstanceTypes.N, Auto Scaling preferentially uses the specified instance types for scale-out. element_fields.description_en:
The level of the instance family in intelligent configuration mode, which is used to filter instance types that meet the requirements. Valid values:

- EntryLevel: entry level, which refers to shared instance types. These instance types are more cost-effective but cannot guarantee stable computing performance. They are suitable for scenarios with low CPU utilization. For more information, see [Shared instance families](~~108489~~).
- EnterpriseLevel: enterprise level. These instance types provide stable performance and dedicated resources. They are suitable for scenarios that require high stability. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~).
- CreditEntryLevel: credit entry level, which refers to burstable instances. These instance types use CPU credits to ensure computing performance. They are suitable for scenarios with low average CPU utilization and occasional bursts. For more information, see [Overview of burstable instances](~~59977~~).

Valid values of N: 1 to 10.
element_fields.description_zh:
智能配置模式下，实例规格族级别，用于筛选符合要求的实例规格范围。取值范围：

- EnterpriseLevel：企业级。性能稳定，资源独享，适用于对稳定性要求高的业务场景。更多信息，请参见[实例规格族](~~25378~~)。
- CreditEntryLevel：积分入门级，即突发性能实例。通过CPU积分来保证计算性能，适用于平时CPU使用率低、偶有突发CPU使用率的情况。更多信息，请参见[突发性能实例](~~59977~~)。

N的取值范围：1~10。

parameters.description_en:
The custom priority of the **instance type + vSwitch** combination.

> This parameter takes effect only when the `scaling policy` of the scaling group is set to `priority policy`.

When an ECS instance cannot be created based on the **instance type + vSwitch** combination with a higher priority, Auto Scaling automatically selects the next-priority **instance type + vSwitch** combination to create the instance.

> If you specify custom priorities for only some **instance type + vSwitch** combinations, the unspecified combinations have lower priorities than the specified ones. The unspecified combinations are still prioritized based on the vSwitch order of the scaling group and the instance type order of the scaling configuration. For example, if the vSwitch order of the scaling group is vsw1 and vsw2, the instance type order of the scaling configuration is type1 and type2, and the custom priority order is `["vsw2+type2", "vsw1+type2"]`, the final priority is `vsw2+type2` > `vsw1+type2` > `vsw1+type1` > `vsw2+type1`.

- host: The instance is associated with the dedicated host. When an instance that has the economical mode enabled is restarted, the instance remains on the original dedicated host. If the original dedicated host has insufficient resources, the instance fails to restart.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
专有宿主机实例是否与专有宿主机关联。取值范围：

v1_parameters.description_en:
The number of vCPUs.

You can specify both CPU and Memory to define the range of instance types. For example, CPU=2 and Memory=16 defines all instance types with 2 vCPUs and 16 GiB of memory. Auto Scaling determines the set of active instance types based on factors such as I/O optimized settings and zones, and then creates instances of the lowest-priced instance type based on price sorting.

>This configuration takes effect only when the cost optimization pattern is enabled and no instance type is specified in the scaling configuration.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
vCPU个数。

同时指定CPU和Memory可以定义实例规格范围，例如，CPU=2且Memory=16可以定义配置为2 vCPU和16 GiB的所有实例规格。弹性伸缩会结合I/O优化、可用区等因素确定可用实例规格集合，并根据价格排序为您创建价格最低的实例。

>该区间配置效果仅在成本优化模式下且伸缩配置未设置实例规格时生效。

v1_parameters.description_en:
The custom priority of the **instance type + vSwitch** combination.

> This parameter takes effect only when the `scaling policy` of the scaling group is set to `priority policy`.

When an ECS instance cannot be created based on the **instance type + vSwitch** combination with a higher priority, Auto Scaling automatically selects the next-priority **instance type + vSwitch** combination to create the instance.

> If you specify custom priorities for only some **instance type + vSwitch** combinations, the unspecified combinations have lower priorities than the specified ones. The unspecified combinations are still prioritized based on the vSwitch order of the scaling group and the instance type order of the scaling configuration. For example, if the vSwitch order of the scaling group is vsw1 and vsw2, the instance type order of the scaling configuration is type1 and type2, and the custom priority order is `["vsw2+type2", "vsw1+type2"]`, the final priority is `vsw2+type2` > `vsw1+type2` > `vsw1+type1` > `vsw2+type1`.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
**ECS实例规格+虚拟交换机**组合的自定义优先级。

>该参数仅在伸缩组的``扩缩容策略``为`优先级策略`时有效。

当无法根据优先级较高的**ECS实例规格+虚拟交换机**创建ECS实例时，弹性伸缩服务会自动选择下一优先级的**ECS实例规格+虚拟交换机**组合来创建ECS实例。

>如果仅指定了部分**ECS实例规格+虚拟交换机**组合的自定义优先级，则未指定的组合优先级低于指定的组合优先级，且未指定的组合仍会依次按照伸缩组的虚拟交换机顺序、伸缩配置的实例规格顺序确定优先级。例如：伸缩组的虚拟交换机顺序依次为vsw1、vsw2，伸缩配置的实例规格顺序依次为type1、type2，该组合的自定义优先级顺序为`["vsw2+type2", "vsw1+type2"]`，则最终优先级为`vsw2+type2`> `vsw1+type2` > `vsw1+type1` > `vsw2+type1`。

- true: enables release protection. The instance cannot be directly released from the ECS console or by calling the API operation. This prevents instances scaled out by Auto Scaling from being accidentally deleted.
- false: disables release protection. The instance can be directly released from the ECS console or by calling the API operation.

> This property does not affect normal scale-in activities. Pay-as-you-go instances with release protection enabled can still be released during scale-in activities.

>该属性不影响弹性伸缩正常的缩容活动，即弹性伸缩发生缩容活动时，开启实例释放保护的按量付费实例可以被正常释放掉。

- Windows instances: The hostname must be 2 to 15 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot contain periods (.) or consist of only digits. 
- Other instances (such as Linux): The hostname must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain multiple periods (.). Each segment between two periods (.) can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

v1_parameters.description_en:
The ID of the image file used for automatic creation of instances.

> If the image previously used in the scaling configuration includes a system cloud disk and data cloud disks, the data cloud disk information is purged after you change the image.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
镜像文件ID，自动创建实例时使用的镜像资源。

> 如果伸缩配置之前使用的镜像包括系统盘和数据盘，修改此镜像后，原数据盘信息会被清除。
v1_parameters.name: ImageId

v1_parameters.description_en:
The name of the image. Image names must be unique within a region. If you specify ImageId, ImageName is ignored.


You cannot use ImageName to specify images from Alibaba Cloud Marketplace.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
镜像文件名称，同一个地域内镜像名称唯一。如果设置了ImageId，ImageName将被忽略。


不支持通过ImageName设置镜像市场镜像。
v1_parameters.name: ImageName

v1_parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether the ECS instance uses the ecs-user account to log on. For more information, see [Manage logon names of ECS instances](~~388447~~). Valid values:

- true: The ECS instance uses the ecs-user account to log on.

- false: The ECS instance does not use the ecs-user account to log on.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
ECS实例是否使用ecs-user用户登录，更多信息，请参见[管理ECS实例的登录名](~~388447~~)。取值范围：

- true：是。

- false：否。
v1_parameters.name: ImageOptions.LoginAsNonRoot

v1_parameters.description_en: The description of the ECS instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
v1_parameters.description_zh: ECS实例的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
v1_parameters.name: InstanceDescription

v1_parameters.description_en: The name of the ECS instance that is created by automatic creation using the scaling configuration.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 使用本伸缩配置自动创建的ECS实例的名称。
v1_parameters.name: InstanceName

v1_parameters.description_en: The information about instance types in intelligent mode.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 智能模式下实例规格相关信息。
v1_parameters.name: InstancePatternInfo

v1_parameters.description_en: The information about instance types.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 实例规格相关信息。
v1_parameters.name: InstanceTypeOverride

v1_parameters.description_en:
The instance types for multiple instance type support. If InstanceTypes.N is specified, InstanceType is ignored. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This means that you can specify up to 20 instance types in a scaling configuration.

N represents the priority of the instance type in the scaling configuration. A smaller value of N indicates a higher priority. When an instance cannot be created by using the instance type with the highest priority, Auto Scaling automatically uses the next-priority instance type to create the instance.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
多实例规格参数。如果使用了InstanceTypes.N，InstanceType将被忽略，其中N的取值范围：1~20，即一个伸缩配置内最多可以设置20种实例规格。

N代表当前伸缩配置中实例规格的优先级，编号为1的实例规格优先级最高，实例规格优先级随着编号的增大依次降低。当无法根据优先级较高的实例规格创建出实例时，弹性伸缩服务会自动选择下一优先级的实例规格来创建实例。
v1_parameters.name: InstanceTypes

v1_parameters.description_en:
The billing method for network usage. Valid values:

- PayByBandwidth: You are charged for the fixed bandwidth that you specify by using InternetMaxBandwidthOut. 
- PayByTraffic: You are charged based on the actual network traffic. InternetMaxBandwidthOut specifies only the maximum outbound bandwidth.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
网络计费类型。取值范围：

- PayByBandwidth：按带宽计费。此时InternetMaxBandwidthOut即为所选的固定带宽值。 
- PayByTraffic：按流量计费。此时InternetMaxBandwidthOut只是一个带宽上限，计费以实际产生的网络流量为依据。
v1_parameters.name: InternetChargeType

v1_parameters.description_en:
The maximum inbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

- If the maximum outbound public bandwidth is less than or equal to 10 Mbit/s: 1 to 10. Default value: 10.
- If the maximum outbound public bandwidth is greater than 10 Mbit/s: 1 to the value of `InternetMaxBandwidthOut`. Default value: the value of `InternetMaxBandwidthOut`.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
公网入带宽最大值，单位为 Mbit/s。取值范围：

- 当所购公网出带宽小于等于 10 Mbit/s 时：1~10，默认为 10。
- 当所购公网出带宽大于 10 Mbit/s 时：1~`InternetMaxBandwidthOut`的取值，默认为`InternetMaxBandwidthOut`的取值。
v1_parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthIn

v1_parameters.description_en:
The maximum outbound bandwidth to the Internet. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
公网出带宽最大值，单位为 Mbit/s。取值范围：0~100。

默认值：0。
v1_parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut

v1_parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether the instance is an I/O optimized instance. Valid values:
- none: The instance is not an I/O optimized instance.
- optimized: The instance is an I/O optimization instance.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
是否为I/O优化实例。取值范围：
- none：非I/O优化实例。
- optimized：I/O优化实例。
v1_parameters.name: IoOptimized

v1_parameters.description_en: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses allocated to the network interface controller (NIC).
v1_parameters.description_zh: 为弹性网卡指定随机生成的IPv6地址数量。
v1_parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount

v1_parameters.description_en:
The name of the key pair used to log on to the ECS instance. 
         
- For Windows instances, this parameter is ignored and is empty by default. 
- For Linux instances, password-based logon is disabled during initialization.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
登录ECS实例时使用的密钥对的名称。 
         
- 对Windows实例，该参数将被忽略，默认为空。 
- 对Linux实例，密码登录方式会被初始化成禁止。
v1_parameters.name: KeyPairName

v1_parameters.description_en: The weight of SLB backend server. Valid values: 1 to 100.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 后端服务器的权重，取值范围：1~100。
v1_parameters.name: LoadBalancerWeight

v1_parameters.description_en:
The memory size.

You can specify both CPU and Memory to define the range of instance types. For example, CPU=2 and Memory=16 defines all instance types with 2 vCPUs and 16 GiB of memory. Auto Scaling determines the set of active instance types based on factors such as I/O optimized settings and zones, and then creates instances of the lowest-priced instance type based on price sorting.

>This configuration takes effect only when the cost optimization pattern is enabled and no instance type is specified in the scaling configuration.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
内存大小。

同时指定CPU和Memory可以定义实例规格范围，例如，CPU=2且Memory=16可以定义配置为2 vCPU和16 GiB的所有实例规格。弹性伸缩会结合I/O优化、可用区等因素确定可用实例规格集合，并根据价格排序为您创建价格最低的实例。

>该区间配置效果仅在成本优化模式下且伸缩配置未设置实例规格时生效。
v1_parameters.name: Memory

v1_parameters.description_en: The list of elastic network interfaces (ENIs).
v1_parameters.description_zh: 弹性网卡列表。
v1_parameters.name: NetworkInterfaces

v1_parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to override existing data. Valid values:
- true: overrides existing data.
- false: does not override existing data.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
是否覆盖。取值范围：
- true：覆盖。
- false：不覆盖。
v1_parameters.name: Override

v1_parameters.description_en:
The password of the ECS instance. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported:

`()~!@#$%^&*-_+=\|{}[]:;'<>,.?/

For Windows instances, the password cannot start with a forward slash (/).

> If you specify the Password parameter, use HTTPS to send the request to avoid password leaks.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
ECS实例的密码。长度为8至30个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。特殊符号可以是：

`()~!@#$%^&*-_+=\|{}[]:;'<>,.?/

其中，Windows实例不能以斜线号（/）为密码首字符。

> 如果传入Password参数，建议您使用HTTPS协议发送请求，避免密码泄露。
v1_parameters.name: Password

v1_parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to use the password preset in the image. To use this parameter, make sure that a password is configured for the image.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 是否使用镜像预设的密码。使用该参数时，您需要确保使用的镜像已经设置了密码。
v1_parameters.name: PasswordInherit

v1_parameters.description_en: The ID of the private pool. The ID of an elasticity assurance or capacity reservation.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 私有池ID。即弹性保障服务ID或容量预定服务ID。
v1_parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.Id

v1_parameters.description_en:
The private pool option for instance startup. A private pool is generated after an elasticity assurance or capacity reservation takes effect. You can select a private pool when you start an instance. Valid values:

- Open: open mode. The system automatically matches available open private pools. If no matching private pools are available, the public pool is used to start the instance. You do not need to specify PrivatePoolOptions.Id.

- Target: specified mode. A specified private pool is used to start the instance. If the specified private pool is unavailable, the instance fails to start. You must specify the private pool ID, which means that PrivatePoolOptions.Id is required.

- None: none mode. No private pool is used to start the instance.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
实例启动的私有池容量选项。弹性保障服务或容量预定服务在生效后会生成私有池容量，供实例启动时选择。取值范围：

- Open：开放模式。将自动匹配开放类型的私有池容量。如果没有符合条件的私有池容量，则使用公共池资源启动。该模式下无需设置PrivatePoolOptions.Id参数。

- Target：指定模式。使用指定的私有池容量启动实例，如果该私有池容量不可用，则实例会启动失败。该模式下必须指定私有池ID，即PrivatePoolOptions.Id参数为必填项。

- None：不使用模式。实例启动将不使用私有池容量。
v1_parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.MatchCriteria

v1_parameters.description_en: The name of the RAM role associated with the ECS instance. The name is provided and maintained by RAM. You can call [ListRoles](~~28713~~) to query available RAM roles. For more information about how to create a RAM role, see [CreateRole](~~28710~~).
v1_parameters.description_zh: ECS实例的RAM角色名称。RAM角色名称由RAM提供和维护，您可调用[ListRoles](~~28713~~)接口查询可用的RAM角色。创建RAM角色的方法，请参见API [CreateRole](~~28710~~)。
v1_parameters.name: RamRoleName

v1_parameters.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the ECS instance belongs.
v1_parameters.description_zh: ECS实例所属资源组的ID。
v1_parameters.name: ResourceGroupId

v1_parameters.description_en:
The resource pool policy used when creating instances. Note the following items after you specify this parameter:

- This parameter takes effect only when creating pay-as-you-go instances.

- This parameter cannot be specified together with PrivatePoolOptions.MatchCriteria or PrivatePoolOptions.Id.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
创建实例时使用的资源池策略。当您设置该参数后，需要注意：

- 该参数只在创建按量付费实例时生效。

- 该参数不能与PrivatePoolOptions.MatchCriteria、PrivatePoolOptions.Id同时设置。
v1_parameters.name: ResourcePoolOptions

v1_parameters.description_en: The ID of the scaling configuration that you want to modify.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 待修改伸缩配置的ID。
v1_parameters.name: ScalingConfigurationId

v1_parameters.description_en:
The name of the scaling configuration. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). It must start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character.

The name must be unique within a scaling group in the same region. If you do not specify this parameter, the scaling configuration ID is used by default.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
伸缩配置的名称，2~64个英文或中文字符，以数字、大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）或半角句号（.）。

在同一地域下同一伸缩组内伸缩配置名称唯一。如果您没有指定该参数，则默认使用伸缩配置的ID。
v1_parameters.name: ScalingConfigurationName

v1_parameters.description_en: The scheduler options.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 调度选项。
v1_parameters.name: SchedulerOptions

v1_parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether a vSwitch must be selected from the VSwitchIds list for secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) when the VSwitchIds parameter is configured.

* Strict: strict mode. If no vSwitch in VSwitchIds meets the requirements, instance creation fails.
* Tolerant: tolerant mode. If no vSwitch in VSwitchIds meets the requirements, no secondary network interface controller (NIC) is configured, but the instance is still created as active.

Default value: Strict.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
当辅助网卡设置 VSwitchIds 参数时，是否必须从列表中选择一个可用于辅助弹性网卡的虚拟交换机。

* Strict：严格模式。若 VSwitchIds 中不存在任何满足条件的虚拟交换机，则创建实例失败。
* Tolerant：容错模式。若 VSwitchIds 中不存在任何满足条件的虚拟交换机，则不设置任何辅助网卡，实例仍可正常创建。

默认值：Strict。
v1_parameters.name: SecondaryEniVSwitchConstraint

v1_parameters.description_en: The ID of the security group to which the ECS instance belongs. ECS instances in the same security group can access each other.
v1_parameters.description_zh: ECS实例所属的安全组的ID，同一个安全组内的ECS实例可以互相访问。
v1_parameters.name: SecurityGroupId

v1_parameters.description_en:
The IDs of the security groups to which the ECS instance is added. The valid values of N depend on the maximum number of security groups to which an instance can belong. For more information, see the security group section in [Limits](~~25412~~).

> You cannot specify both SecurityGroupId and SecurityGroupIds.N.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
将ECS实例同时加入多个安全组。N的取值范围与实例能够加入安全组上限有关。更多详情，请参见[使用限制](~~25412~~)下的安全组章节。

> 不支持同时指定SecurityGroupId和SecurityGroupIds.N。
v1_parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds

v1_parameters.description_en: The security options.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 安全选项。
v1_parameters.name: SecurityOptions

v1_parameters.description_en:
The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hours. Valid values:

- 1: After a spot instance is created, Alibaba Cloud ensures that the instance is not automatically released within 1 hour. After the 1-hour protection period ends, the system compares the bid price with the market price and checks the resource inventory to determine whether to retain automatic release the instance.
- 0: After a spot instance is created, Alibaba Cloud does not ensure that the instance runs for 1 hour. The system compares the bid price with the market price and checks the resource inventory to determine whether to retain automatic release the instance.

>Alibaba Cloud sends an ECS system event notification 5 minutes before the instance is released. Spot instances are billed by second. Select an appropriate protection period based on the expected task execution duration.

Default value: 1.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
抢占式实例的保留时长，单位为小时。取值范围：

- 1：创建后阿里云会保证实例运行1小时不会被自动释放；超过1小时后，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的保留或回收。
- 0：创建后，阿里云不能保证实例运行1小时，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的保留或回收。

>实例被回收前5分钟内，阿里云会通过ECS系统事件向您发送通知。抢占式实例按秒计费，建议您结合具体任务执行耗时来选择合适的保留时长。

默认值：1。
v1_parameters.name: SpotDuration

v1_parameters.description_en: The interruption mode of the spot instance. Only Terminate (default) is supported, which directly releases the instance.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 抢占实例中断模式。目前仅支持Terminate（默认）直接释放实例。
v1_parameters.name: SpotInterruptionBehavior

v1_parameters.description_en: The collection of spot instance information.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 抢占式实例信息的集合。
v1_parameters.name: SpotPriceLimit

v1_parameters.description_en:
The preemption policy for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:
         
- NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
- SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is automatically used as the bid price.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
后付费实例的抢占策略。取值范围：
         
- NoSpot：普通的按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。
v1_parameters.name: SpotStrategy

v1_parameters.description_en: The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 存储集ID。
v1_parameters.name: StorageSetId

v1_parameters.description_en: The maximum number of partitions in the dedicated block storage cluster. Valid values: greater than or equal to 2.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 存储集中的最大分区数量。取值范围：大于等于2。
v1_parameters.name: StorageSetPartitionNumber

v1_parameters.description_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy that is applied to the system cloud disk.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 系统盘使用的自动快照策略ID。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.AutoSnapshotPolicyId

v1_parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the burst feature for the system cloud disk. Valid values:

- true: enables the burst feature.
- false: does not enable the burst feature. 
> This parameter is supported only when `SystemDisk.Category` is set to `cloud_auto`.

<props="china">For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL cloud disks](~~368372~~).</props>
v1_parameters.description_zh:
系统盘是否开启Burst（性能突发）。取值范围：

- true：开启。
- false：未开启。 
> 当`SystemDisk.Category`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。

<props="china">更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL云盘](~~368372~~)。</props>
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.BurstingEnabled

v1_parameters.description_en:
The category of the system cloud disk. Valid values:

- cloud: basic cloud disk. The DeleteWithInstance attribute of a basic cloud disk that is created together with the instance is set to true.
- cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
- cloud_essd: ESSD.
- ephemeral_ssd: local SSD.
- cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk.

You cannot specify this parameter together with `SystemDiskCategories.N`. If neither this parameter nor `SystemDiskCategories.N` is specified, the default value is used. If the instance type is a Series I instance type and the instance is a non-I/O optimized instance, the default value is cloud. Otherwise, the default value is cloud_efficiency.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
系统盘的磁盘种类。取值范围：

- cloud：普通云盘。随实例创建的普通云盘的DeleteWithInstance属性为true。
- cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
- cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
- cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。
- ephemeral_ssd：本地SSD盘。
- cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。

该参数不能与`SystemDiskCategories.N`同时指定。当该参数与`SystemDiskCategories.N`都未指定时，该参数有默认值。InstanceType为系列I的实例规格且实例属于非I/O优化实例时，默认值：cloud。否则，默认值：cloud_efficiency。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.Category

v1_parameters.description_en: The description of the system cloud disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 系统盘的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.Description

v1_parameters.description_en: The name of the system cloud disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
v1_parameters.description_zh: 系统盘的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.DiskName

v1_parameters.description_en:
The encryption algorithm used for the system cloud disk. Valid values:

- AES-256.
- SM4-128.

Default value: AES-256.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
系统盘采用的加密算法。取值范围：

- AES-256。
- SM4-128。

默认值：AES-256。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.EncryptAlgorithm

v1_parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the system cloud disk. Valid values:

- true: encrypts the system cloud disk.
- false: does not encrypt the system cloud disk.

Default value: false.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
是否加密系统盘。取值范围：

- true：加密。
- false：不加密。

默认值：false。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.Encrypted

v1_parameters.description_en: The ID of the KMS key used for the system cloud disk.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 系统盘使用的KMS密钥ID。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.KMSKeyId

v1_parameters.description_en:
The performance level (PL) of the system cloud disk when it is an ESSD. Valid values:

- PL0: A single ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL1: A single ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL2: A single ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL3: A single ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

> For more information about how to select an ESSD performance level, see [ESSDs](~~122389~~).
v1_parameters.description_zh:
当系统盘为ESSD云盘时，设置云盘的性能等级。取值范围：

- PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
- PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
- PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
- PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。

> 关于如何选择ESSD云盘性能等级，请参见[ESSD云盘](~~122389~~)。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.PerformanceLevel

v1_parameters.description_en:
The provisioned IOPS (Input/Output Operations Per Second) performance metrics for the system cloud disk.

> IOPS (Input/Output Operations Per Second) measures the number of read and write (output/input) operations that a block storage device can process per second.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
系统盘预配置的IOPS（Input/Output Operations Per Second）性能指标。

> IOPS（Input/Output Operations Per Second）指每秒能处理的I/O个数，表示块存储处理读写（输出/输入）的能力，单位为次。
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk.ProvisionedIops

v1_parameters.description_en:
The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

- Basic cloud disk: 20 to 500.
- ESSD:
    - PL0: 1 to 2048.
    - PL1: 20 to 2048.

v1_parameters.description_en:
The multiple disk types for the system cloud disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 4. You can specify up to four disk types for the system cloud disk in a scaling configuration. A smaller value of N indicates a higher priority. When a disk type with a higher priority is unavailable, Auto Scaling automatically attempts the next-priority disk type to create the system cloud disk. Valid values:
- cloud: basic cloud disk.
- cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
- cloud_essd: ESSD.

> If you specify this parameter, you cannot specify `SystemDisk.Category` at the same time.

v1_parameters.description_en:
The tags of the ECS instance. Tags are specified as key-value pairs. You can specify up to 20 tags. The following limits apply to keys and values: 
         
- A key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. You cannot specify an empty string as a key. 
- A value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The value can be an empty string.
